description:
Damage areas for Flood, Nepal, 26 August 2026 (FL20260826NPL): 20 features merged from 15 source layers. Polygon layers with a damage class column: damaged areas, zones, or density cells. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Mudflow/Rockflow Impact Assessment in Rasuwa & Nuwakot Districts, Bagmati Province, Nepal as of  26–27 August 2026](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mudflow-rockflow-impact-assessment-in-rasuwa-nuwakot-districts-bagmati-province-nepal-as-o)
- [Satellite-Detected Newly Formed Barrier Lakes Following an Ice-Rock Avalanche in Rasuwa District, Nepal, as of 28 August 2026](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/newly-formed-barrier-lakes-following-an-ice-rock-avalanche-in-rasuwa-district-nepal-as-of-)
- [Satellite-detected Mudflow/ rockflow extent as of 26–27  August 2026 in Rasuwa District, Bagmati Province, Nepal](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mudflow-rockflow-extent-as-of-26-27-august-2026-in-rasuwa-district-bagmati-province-nepal)
- [Satellite-detected Mudflow/ rockflow extent as of 26–27 August 2026 in Nuwakot District, Bagmati Province, Nepal](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mudflow-rockflow-extent-as-of-26-27-august-2026-in-nuwakot-district-bagmati-province-nepal)
- [UNOSAT Live web map](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/unosat-live-web-map)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SiteID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Stadium; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church; 48 = Dam; 49 = Port; 50 = Power station; 51 = Power tower; 52 = Railway. The decoded text is in `SiteID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 53 = Jilin-1; 54 = GaoFen-2; 55 = SkySat; 56 = ICEYE; 57 = Landsat-9; 58 = VIIRS-NOAA; 59 = RCM-1; 60 = RCM-2; 61 = RCM-3; 62 = TanDEM-X; 63 = BlackSky; …. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Destroyed; 2 = Severely damaged; 3 = Moderately damaged; 4 = Possible damage; 5 = Impact crater (damage to road); 6 = No visible damage; 7 = Impact crater (damage to field); 8 = Destroyed (demolition zone); 9 = Suspected phosphorus shell attack zone; 10 = Road damage from tank passage; 11 = Possible damage from adjacent impact, debris; 12 = Lava flow; 13 = Damage. The decoded text is in `Main_Damage_Site_Class_label`.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Damaged Buildings; 2 = Damaged Greenhouses; 3 = Impacts on Roads / Bridges; 4 = Impacts in Fields; 5 = Damaged Road segments; 6 = Damaged Port. The decoded text is in `Grouped_Damage_Classes_label`.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 18 = TH; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 45 = MD; 54 = HP; 55 = VG; 57 = PG; 66 = CJ; 70 = SG; 73 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 91 = KA; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 141 = KJP; 151 = MNY; 161 = DC; 171 = SR; 181 = NL; 191 = DH; 212 = MH; 213 = JT; 214 = ES; 215 = KB; 216 = JY; 218 = PA; 219 = SS; 220 = YM; 221 = IS; 223 = KRS; 224 = AZ; 225 = RP; 226 = AS; 227 = MDE; 228 = BV; 229 = ZL; 230 = ZT; 231 = AI; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.
